intro: Posture Plus supports you through the night. With targeted back alignment, dual-firmness options, and a moisture-resistant design, it helps you rest deeply and wake up pain-free.

features.title: Better posture starts with the right chair
features.text: Say goodbye to back pain—our design relieves pressure points while aligning your spine for healthier, more restful sleep.

features.title: Dense foam core that supports you all day
features.text: The durable core adapts to your body while offering lasting support—ensuring every night’s sleep is restorative.

features.title: Firm foam for strong, lasting support
features.text: With dual-sided firmness, our mattress lets you choose the comfort you need—soft on one side for plush nights, firm on the other for extra support whenever you want it.

features.title: Breathable quilted fabric keeps you cool
features.text: Enjoy fresher, cooler sleep with our quilted cover, designed to boost airflow and enhance your comfort in every season.

features.title: Made to fit your bed perfectly
features.text: Designed to fit standard beds, our frame offers reliable support while giving your sleep space a polished, put-together look you’ll appreciate every morning.

features.title: Stay reassured with our 10 year warranty
features.text: Rest easy with the assurance of a 10-year warranty. Crafted for durability and reliability, this mattress is backed by our commitment to quality, ensuring years of unmatched comfort and peace of mind.

name: Posture Plus Single Bed Foam Mattress 72 X 36 X 6 Inches
